After the verb वद् , the आत्मनेपद is used, when used in the sense of 'speaking articulately in a similar manner'.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb रम् 'to sport', preceded by वि and आङ् , परस्मैपद is used.

Terms: परस्मैपद

In the छन्दस् (Veda) these गति and उपसर्ग are also seen separated from the verb by intervening words.

Terms: छन्दस्

The object of the verbs व्यवहृ and पण् when they ae synonymous, that is when they mean 'dealing in sale and purchase transactions' or 'staking in gambling' takes the 6th-Case-affix.

Terms: विभक्ति-6

In the छन्दस् (Vedas) there is diversely an interchange of the various विकरण-as शप् etc. which have been previously ordained under special circumstances.

Terms: छन्दस्

The affix अप् comes after the verbs 1. व्यध् 'to hurt or to pierce' 2. जप् 'to mutter' when no उपसर्ग is in composition with them.

Terms: अप्

The affix व्यत् comes after the word भ्रातृ when the sense is that of 'an enemy'.

Terms: व्यत्

An affix comes after a word in the Locative -7th case in construction denoting time, in the sense of 'who then wanders' and the word so formed refers to a wild beast.

Terms: विभक्ति-7

The affix ठक् comes after a word denoting a condiment, being in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction when the sense is 'sprinkled therewith'.

Terms: ठक्

The semi-vowel of व्या (व्ये) 'to cover' is not vocalised when the affix ल्यप् follows.

Terms: सम्प्रसारणम्

In a बहुव्रीहि समास ending in अन्तर the acute accent (उदात्त) is on the final after a word which denotes 'that which lies between'.

Terms: समास end acute-2nd-term

There is vocalisation of the half-vowel of the reduplicate of व्यथ् in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

Terms: Reduplicate
